A '''cave''' on the planet [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] served as the first meeting place between the very first [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], consisting of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Cala Brin]], [[Garon Jard]], [[Ters Sendon]] and [[Rajivari]], before Rajivari fell to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] and [[Rajivari's purges|rose]] against his fellow Council members.
